entities.summary: Yasiel Puig Valdés is a Cuban-born American former professional baseball right fielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Los Angeles Dodgers, Cincinnati Reds, and Cleveland Indians, and in the KBO League for the Kiwoom Heroes. He also played in Mexico, the Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico, and Cuba. His nickname was "The Wild Horse", given to him by longtime Dodgers broadcaster Vin Scully.
